title: Advanced Memory Wafer-to-Wafer Bonding with Support of Recyclable Carrier Systems
notes: Three recyclable carrier schemes (A inorganic film/blade, B IR laser release stack, C glass/photonic) for 3-wafer memory W2W stack; Device 1 <2 um; qualitative results, almost no numbers.

title: Dry processes to form fine features on advanced substrates
notes: Coupon-level DFR lamination, laser digital lithography, ICP+CCP F-based dry etch of ABF on Cu; vias/trenches 5-10 um CD, AR 1-2. No metallization.

title: A Low Profile DC-DC Converter on the Inductor-Embedded-Substrate as an integrated Package Solution (L-type-iPaS) Substrate for Next Vertical Power Delivery
notes: Flat 2-layer 100 um Cu coils in Fe-epoxy metal composite, series arrays in a 3-2-3 substrate; 5 V to 1 V buck, 1.7 vs 2.4 mm module height.

title: Development of Next-Generation Chemical Mechanical Planarization Process for Panel-level Heterogeneous Integration
orgs: Intel Corporation, Substrate Packaging Technology Development and Assembly and Test Technology Development, Chandler, Arizona, USA
notes: Dielectric CMP on 510x515 mm substrate panels: MRR vs P and Vr (Preston P^2/3 V fit), WIPNU, pad conditioning, slurry, TTV; Cu via reveal on embedded-bridge TV. Mostly normalized data.

title: Pre-Treatment for Adhesion Layer in Panel-Level Sputtering Applying an Improved Linear Ion Source
